description: Build the documents and form answers of applications again. Nothing is sent. Uses AI credits.

application_ids.description: Application ids to act on, 1 to 25 (e.g. [1550, 1551]), from getmattered_get_applications

steps.description: The preparation steps to run again. Omit to run every step that is out of date.

name: getmattered_reprepare_applications

decision.description: The operation that ran: approve, reject, cancel, refine, re_prepare or set_stage.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation prompt and nothing was sent.

reason.description: Machine reason when ok is false, or "already_approved" for an approve that had already gone through.

status.description: Our own record after the action. Never proof the employer received it.

setupStep.description: Set while account setup is open: the step to take first.

title: Prepare Applications Again
